purpose: Objective post-tonemap triage for actual native-4K Unity evidence. Metrics expose clipping/crush risk before human review but never award Visual Fidelity points.

displaySpace.source: Final rendered PNG after the deterministic filmic display transform
displaySpace.lumaApproximation: Rec.709 coefficients applied to 8-bit display RGB codes
displaySpace.note: These are display diagnostics, not scene-linear photometry. They cannot prove physical exposure or PBR correctness.

warningPolicy.reason: Global histograms can be legitimately influenced by sky, dark cavities and composition. Thresholds are triage warnings only; the reviewer must inspect the exact sealed full frame and 100% crop before scoring.

lightingShadowsReflections: Use shadow/contact crops to identify likely crushed separation before inspecting the actual pixels.
Do not infer shadow-direction coherence or light leaks from histograms alone.
cinematicImage: Use highlight warnings to inspect concrete, glazing and metal rolloff rather than accepting clipped white patches.
Use dark warnings to inspect whether balcony/stair recesses retain construction and material separation.
Composition, color harmony, sky/foliage naturalness, banding and posterization remain visual-review tasks.
textureMicrodetail: A broad display-range warning can explain hidden microdetail, but metrics cannot prove texture fidelity.

forbiddenInterpretations: Treating a warning-free report as Visual Fidelity PASS
Awarding Cinematic Image or Lighting points from histogram numbers alone
Using histogram thresholds to justify post sharpening, bloom or local clarity masking
Analyzing resized or sharpened crops instead of pixel-exact 100% crops
